Privacy policy

True Lavender LLC · Updated November 3, 2026

This notice describes the current device-local version of Truckload.

What stays on your device

Trip details, load payments, expenses, fuel purchases, truck settings and business budgets are saved locally. Uploaded rate confirmations and extracted text are stored locally in the app or browser. Truckload does not upload these records to an account or cloud database.

Internet connections

The web version is hosted by GitHub Pages. The scan reader downloads OCR engine and English language resources from jsDelivr and Project Naptha. These providers receive ordinary network information such as your IP address when resources are requested; document contents are processed on your device. Their own privacy practices apply to those requests.

Sharing and retention

Records remain until you delete them or the app/browser storage is cleared. Exports and the iPhone share sheet send files only to the destination you choose. Keep your own copies of important records. Removing the app or changing devices may lose local records. Website records do not automatically transfer into the iPhone app.

Control your information

You can delete individual trips, fuel purchases, business expenses and documents within the app. To remove all local data, clear this website's storage in your browser or delete the iPhone app. Copies you exported must be deleted separately. There are no driver accounts in this version.

Security

This version does not add application-level encryption to its local records. Protect your device with a passcode and do not use it to store separate drivers' private information on a shared device.

Tracking and payments

The current application code includes no advertising, analytics, location tracking or subscription payment processing. This notice must be updated if those features or cloud accounts are introduced.

Questions

See Help & support for troubleshooting and the public issue channel. Do not post personal, payment or shipment information there.
